Under Act XLVI of 2012 (Fttv.) s.5(8) Lechner supplies the state cadastral map database for non-official purposes only, refreshed every 3 months, SOLD as full simplified-DAT content or skeleton map (parcel boundary + helyrajzi szam), formats ESRI Shape / DXF, price per hectare (e.g. built-up 0-5 ha 24,000 HUF; rural 0-300 ha 620 HUF/ha). Offers WMS.
